goals.description: Train a demand forecasting model within local workstation limits

metrics.description: Training CPU, memory, output size, and imported run metadata meet development limits

system.usage_context: The model is trained by developers on a local workstation before being promoted to the inventory planning service
risks: Training may overload the developer workstation
Training may consume too much memory
Training outputs may be too large to archive
Training metadata may be incomplete for later review

data.description: Historical store sales and inventory dataset
data.purpose: Training and testing demand forecasting model

labels.name: Weekly demand
labels.description: Observed number of units sold in one week

fields.name: store product features
fields.description: Store, product, calendar, promotion, and sales history features

model.capability_deployment_mechanism: The model is trained locally and then packaged for deployment

input_specification.name: store product features
input_specification.description: Features for one store and product

output_specification.name: Predicted weekly demand
output_specification.description: Predicted number of units demanded next week

system_requirements.stimulus: The local training process runs on the developer workstation
system_requirements.response: The training process keeps average CPU usage within the workstation budget
system_requirements.measure: the average local process CPU utilization is less than 80%

system_requirements.stimulus: The local training process runs on the developer workstation
system_requirements.response: The training process keeps peak memory usage within the workstation budget
system_requirements.measure: the maximum local process memory utilization is less than 8 GB

system_requirements.stimulus: The training process completes and writes model outputs
system_requirements.response: The generated training output bundle remains small enough to archive
system_requirements.measure: the local training output bundle size is no more than 2 GB

system_requirements.stimulus: The training run produces metadata for review
system_requirements.response: The training metadata can be imported into MLTE evidence
system_requirements.measure: the imported JSON evidence includes training duration, random seed, dataset version, and model artifact path
